item.title: Admirals achieve series victory over Gargoyles
item.description: Jack O’Leary had two goals and an assist as the Norfolk Admirals gained a badly needed series victory Sunday, defeating the Greensboro Gargoyles 5-3 before 5,418 at Scope. The Admirals (18-25-2-0) took two of three games in the three-day set, winning in Greensboro (13-26-5-1) before splitting a pair at Scope.
